title: [실습] Dokcer Compose로 MySQL 실행
markdown:
## [실습] Dokcer Compose로 MySQL 실행 --- - Docker CLI로 컨테이너 실행 ```bash $ docker run -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=pwd1234 -p 3306:3306 -v /Users/igyeongseob/Develop/docker-mysql/mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql -d mysql ``` ### Docker Compose로 MySQL 실행
1. compse 파일 작성 compose.yml
nginx + redis + mysql ```yaml services: my-web-server: container_name: webserver image: nginx ports: - 80:80 my-cache-server: container_name: my-redis image: redis ports: - 6379:6379 my-db: container_name: my-mysql image: mysql environment: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: pwd1234 volumes: - /Users/igyeongseob/Develop/docker-mysql/mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql ports: - 3306:3306 ```
```yaml services: my-db: image: mysql environment: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: pwd1234 volumes: - /Users/igyeongseob/Develop/docker-mysql/mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql ports: - 3306:3306 ``` - environment: … - CLI에서 -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=pwd1234 와 동일 - volumes: ... - CLI에서 -v {호스트 경로}:/var/lib/mysql 와 동일
2. compose 파일 실행 ```bash docker compose up -d ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8129-b2ae-ce6b21ce2ae3/ba739ad39448f7fc.webp)
3. compose 실행 현황 보기 ```bash docker compose ls ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8129-b2ae-ce6b21ce2ae3/ad5b87e9ad4c759f.webp) ```bash docker compose ps docker ps ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8129-b2ae-ce6b21ce2ae3/c822a92a3f16cb99.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8129-b2ae-ce6b21ce2ae3/f7ef7dfef03362c4.webp)
4. DB 연결 → 정상 동작 확인 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8129-b2ae-ce6b21ce2ae3/9f9b3c4e5e5f30d8.webp)
Driver properties 변경 필요 - allowPublicKeyRetrieval: false → true ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8129-b2ae-ce6b21ce2ae3/b73d551ca45d56c1.webp) - useSSL: true → false ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8129-b2ae-ce6b21ce2ae3/d247342df853e787.webp)
5. volume 데이터 저장 확인 ```bash # local Voluem 설정 dir로 이동 cd /Users/igyeongseob/Develop/docker-mysql/mysql_data # data 저장 확인 ls # 생성한 db 내부 확인 ls ./mydb ``` - volume으로 설정한 directory로 이동 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8129-b2ae-ce6b21ce2ae3/bf5f65a1c74fb1e5.webp) - 생성한 db 확인 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8129-b2ae-ce6b21ce2ae3/4ee4b4b32ff14972.webp) - 생성한 Table 확인 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8129-b2ae-ce6b21ce2ae3/1b5f7a1b2a7f118d.webp)
6. compose 컨테이너 삭제 ```bash docker compose down ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-8129-b2ae-ce6b21ce2ae3/15870357853f6056.webp)
